sources.title: Require proof of presence for high-impact actions
Local sandboxing in the GitHub Copilot app
OpenTelemetry in the GitHub Copilot app
GitHub Enterprise adds credential inventory exports
Visual Studio Code 1.139: agent sessions in Dev Containers on remote hosts
Azure service updates RSS feed (reviewed for the reporting period)
Azure DevOps Blog (checked, no post published in the reporting period)

claims.claim: GitHub added a public preview feature requiring proof of presence (interactive re-authentication or MFA via the enterprise's IdP) before high-impact actions on EMU enterprises using Microsoft Entra ID, announced 24 September 2026.
Proof of presence sessions remain valid for two hours after a successful challenge, and support for gating pull request merges is planned but not yet available.
GitHub Copilot app now supports local sandboxing to limit agent access to files, network resources and credentials, configured per project, announced 23 September 2026.
GitHub Copilot app now supports OpenTelemetry configuration through enterprise-managed settings, generally available as of 22 September 2026.
GitHub Enterprise owners can now export a complete inventory of credentials able to access the enterprise, generally available as of 21 September 2026.
VS Code 1.139 (released 23 September 2026) added the ability to run agent sessions inside a project's Dev Container on SSH, Tunnel and WSL remote hosts.
No Azure DevOps Blog post was published inside the reporting period; the two most recent posts found were dated 5 August 2026 and 27 August 2026.

Azure Updates RSS did not surface a CSA-priority announcement inside the reporting period that outranked the GitHub Changelog candidates; the most recent relevant preview items reviewed were dated 21 to 25 September 2026 and covered infrastructure/database services outside this week's editorial focus.

Proof of presence is the strongest candidate for a full article this week because it has the highest combined enterprise impact, CSA relevance, security/governance and novelty scores among verified candidates.
